faq.a: Rachel's List finds wedding dresses, decor and venues for less, matched to the photos a bride loves, every week. It is a wedding-deals service for the US and Canada, at rachelslist.co.

faq.q: Is Rachel's List the Australian freelance job board?
faq.a: No. Rachel's List (rachelslist.co) is a US and Canada wedding-deals service, not the Australian freelance job board of the same name (rachelslist.com.au).

faq.q: How does Rachel's List find deals?
faq.a: You tap the styles you love. Rachel's List searches Poshmark, Etsy and venues every week for the looks you tap, and new finds land on your board every Tuesday. Free to start.

faq.q: Do you earn money from the sellers or venues on these pages?
faq.a: No. There are no affiliate links, and we earn nothing from any seller or venue listed. The only button on a page leads to Rachel's List, our own app, free to start.

faq.q: Where do the prices in the guides come from?
faq.a: Courthouse fees come from the county or city clerk's own web page and are quoted word for word. Venue and photographer prices come from their own websites. Dress prices come from the Poshmark listing, re-opened on the day shown. See how we check every price.
